text:
oliver: heads-up — incoming customer request to onboard RaptorX-8B for conversational assistant (Acme Retail). They want a quantized + on-prem variant, low-latency SLOs, and strong determinism for audits. link to artifact: s3://redwood-internal/onboard/raptorx-8b/manifest.json :eyes:

maria: thanks. any priority/commit from sales?

oliver: sales says P1 (pilot next month) and will provide sample prompt sets. Contract wants p95 < 150ms on 1xA100-ish hardware.

raj: putting triage checklist here, proposed owner: @maria (let me know if you want me to take perf/tests)

maria: I can own quant/bench. steps I'll run:
- smoke: load model, verify logits match baseline at fp32 within tolerance
- quant sweep: 8-bit GPTQ -> eval quality on customer prompts and eval set
- perf: measure p50/p95 with batching 1..8, measure memory + KV cache behaviour
- regression: run diff against redwood-bench-7b baseline to catch hallucination/score drops

sophia: tagging infra: need a dedicated node for deterministic runs (no preemption). i'll reserve a 1xA100 for 48h and a 2xA100 if needed for throughput test.

oliver: can we capture these as quick commands for repeatability? e.g.
```
# smoke load
redwoodctl model load --name raptorx-8b --path s3://... --quant none
redwoodctl run eval --model raptorx-8b --evalset customer_prompts.json --out /tmp/raptorx-smoke.json
```

maria: perfect. i'll post outputs to the onboarding folder and add perf notes.

quant-bot: automated note: queued quant job #Q-482 for raptorx-8b (GPTQ-8) on reserved-node-12. ETA ~3h.

raj: test matrix to prioritize (P1->P3):
P1: correctness on customer prompts, p95 latency baseline (batch=1), quant 8-bit GPTQ quality check
P2: throughput with batching, autoscale behavior, fallback to hosted small model
P3: long-run memory leak check, A/B eval for content safety

oliver: for canary/rollout plan: prefer incremental rollout to dedicated pilot cluster -> A/B with ratio 10% -> 50% -> 100% if no regressions. golden set: 200 prompts from customer + 100 internal safety prompts.

maria: quick ask — does on-prem package require HSM/KMS config? customer asked for HSM keys. sophia?

sophia: yes, will need KMS integration and some extra audit logs. i added a ticket to infra (INF-1289).

oliver: blockers?

maria: two: 1) need the model conversion recipe (fp32 weights + tokenizer) from customer, 2) need permission to access their prompts for eval (legal sign-off).

raj: for quality regressions, i'll add smoke eval thresholds as alerts:
- exact-match increase >2%
- safety filter fail rate >1%
- average token logprob drop >0.5

maria: will upload initial eval artifacts by EOD tomorrow. tagging @oliver for rollout decision after results. :thumbsup:

oliver: thanks all — i'll update the intake doc and assign canary owner after we see the quant results.
